focuses.name: The Commissar of the Urals
focuses.desc:
Genrikh Yagoda ran the NKVD once, and Moscow took it from him. Now Moscow has fallen, and the Urals answer to him.

Starting spirits (negative): The Organs Rule, Fear of the Commissar, Cut Off from the Union.

Effect: +5% stability.

focuses.name: Proclaim the Marxist Republic
focuses.desc:
A republic of workers and soldiers, run by the men who used to arrest them.

Effect: +50 political power.

focuses.name: Dissolve the Sverdlovsk Soviet
focuses.desc:
The city soviet thought it could choose its own chairman.

Effect: -5% stability, +5% war support.

focuses.name: The Party Answers to the Organs
focuses.desc:
Every party committee gets an NKVD officer, and he signs the minutes.

Effect: +0.05 daily political power.

focuses.name: Rule Through the Party
focuses.desc:
Keep the forms of Soviet power, and fill them with his men.

Effect: communist popularity +10%, +5% stability.

focuses.name: Rule Through the Organs
focuses.desc:
Do away with the pretence. The Commissariat is the government.

Effect: The Organs Rule strengthened; +10% political power gain.

focuses.name: The Order State
focuses.desc:
Everything permitted is written down. Everything not written down is forbidden.

Effect: +10% stability, -5% war support.

focuses.name: Every Citizen Registered
focuses.desc:
A card for every person in the republic: name, work, address, reliability.

Effect: +5% stability, +manpower.

focuses.name: Internal Passports
focuses.desc:
No travel between towns without a stamp from the organs.

Effect: -5% stability, +resistance to enemy spies.

focuses.name: The Long Curfew
focuses.desc:
Off the streets at nine. Lights out at ten.

Effect: +5% stability, -5% factory output.

focuses.name: One Voice in Tyumen
focuses.desc:
One newspaper, one radio station, one chairman.

Effect: +10% war support.

focuses.name: Portraits of Genrikh Yagoda
focuses.desc:
A small man in a commissar's tunic, on every wall in the Urals.

Effect: +5% stability.

focuses.name: No Successor Named
focuses.desc:
Anyone who might replace him is watched more closely than anyone else.

Effect: +0.05 daily political power, -5% stability.

focuses.name: The Grip Tightens
focuses.desc:
Every lever in the republic now runs through one office in Tyumen.

Effect: +10% stability, The Organs Rule at its strongest.

focuses.name: Absolute Order
focuses.desc:
Nothing moves in the Urals that the organs have not allowed. It is the most orderly state in Russia, and it cannot last.

Effect: the end of the tree. The collapse mechanic (to be added) takes it from here.

focuses.name: Rebuild the Organs
focuses.desc:
The NKVD officers who came over with him become the core of a new Commissariat.

Effect: +50 political power.

focuses.name: Informers in Every Block
focuses.desc:
Every apartment block has a man who writes reports.

Effect: +5% stability, -5% war support.

focuses.name: The Special Departments
focuses.desc:
An NKVD officer in every regiment, answering only to Tyumen.

Effect: -5% division organisation, no coup from the army.

focuses.name: Camps of the Urals
focuses.desc:
The old Gulag camps around Sverdlovsk fill up again.

Effect: +manpower for labour, -5% stability.

focuses.name: A File on Everyone
focuses.desc:
Cabinets of index cards in the basement of the Tyumen Commissariat.

Effect: +intelligence.

focuses.name: Open Terror
focuses.desc:
Arrests at night, trials by morning, and everyone knows.

Effect: Fear of the Commissar grows; +10% stability for a year, then -10%.

focuses.name: Silent Surveillance
focuses.desc:
Nobody is arrested. Everybody is watched.

Effect: Fear of the Commissar eases; -0.05 daily political power.

focuses.name: Who Watches the Watchers
focuses.desc:
A second commissariat to watch the first.

Effect: +5% stability.

focuses.name: Yagoda's Own Guard
focuses.desc:
One regiment that answers to him personally, quartered next to his office.

Effect: a guard division.

focuses.name: Whispers in the Party
focuses.desc:
It happens anyway. Party men meet in kitchens and talk about who comes after Yagoda.

Effect: -5% stability.

focuses.name: The Officers Resent the Organs
focuses.desc:
It happens anyway. Every colonel with a commissar at his elbow is a colonel waiting for his moment.

Effect: -5% stability, -5% war support.

focuses.name: Cracks in the Order
focuses.desc:
It happens anyway. The more tightly he holds the Urals, the more of it slips through his fingers.

Effect: -10% stability.

focuses.name: Seize the Chelyabinsk Institute
focuses.desc:
The Institute for All Research is the greatest prize in the Urals. NKVD troops take the building, the laboratories and every scientist in them.

Effect: the Institute's research bonus is secured; +5% research speed.

focuses.name: Scientists Under Guard
focuses.desc:
They work, they eat and they sleep inside the wire.

Effect: +5% research speed, -5% stability.

focuses.name: The Urals Sharashka
focuses.desc:
A prison design bureau, as the NKVD ran in the 1930s: arrested engineers working for their freedom.

Effect: tech bonus for one industry and one weapons technology.

focuses.name: Weapons for the Organs
focuses.desc:
The Institute designs what the Commissariat needs: rifles, radios, armoured cars.

Effect: tech bonuses for infantry weapons and support equipment.

focuses.name: Machines for the Factories
focuses.desc:
The Institute designs what Uralmash needs.

Effect: tech bonuses for industry.

focuses.name: The Kyshtym Project
focuses.desc:
A closed town by Lake Kyzyltash, south of Sverdlovsk, where the Institute's physicists work on something nobody may name.

Effect: +nuclear research.

focuses.name: Prisoners Who Invent
focuses.desc:
The sharashka's best engineers are promised their freedom. None of them get it.

Effect: +5% research speed.

focuses.name: Uralmash Under the Organs
focuses.desc:
The Ural heavy machinery works gets a new director from the Commissariat.

Effect: +1 civilian factory.

focuses.name: Tankograd
focuses.desc:
The Chelyabinsk tractor works built tanks for the whole war. It can build them for the republic.

Effect: +1 military factory.

focuses.name: Prisoners for the Mines
focuses.desc:
The camps supply the mines with labour that cannot leave.

Effect: +steel, -5% stability.

focuses.name: Grain from Tobolsk
focuses.desc:
The only farmland the republic holds is along the Tobol and the Irtysh.

Effect: food shortages ease.

focuses.name: The Sverdlovsk Arms Works
focuses.desc:
Rifles and machine guns for the NKVD troops.

Effect: +1 military factory.

focuses.name: Rations by Reliability
focuses.desc:
Bread by category: reliable, doubtful, enemy.

Effect: +5% stability, Fear of the Commissar grows.

focuses.name: The Commissariat's Plan
focuses.desc:
A five-year plan drawn up by policemen.

Effect: +5% construction speed, +5% factory output.

focuses.name: NKVD Troops
focuses.desc:
The republic's army is the Commissariat's own internal troops.

Effect: +army experience.

focuses.name: The Border Guard Divisions
focuses.desc:
NKVD border guards, the best-equipped soldiers in the Urals.

Effect: +5% defence.

focuses.name: Hold the Ural Passes
focuses.desc:
West lies the Reichskommissariat, east lies Popov. The passes must hold.

Effect: forts at the border.

focuses.name: Tanks for the Organs
focuses.desc:
Tankograd's tanks go to NKVD units, not the army.

Effect: tanks added to the stockpile.
